Form status is set by data entry staff in REDCap. Incomplete forms usually have a required field left blank.

Data quality

The quality checks flagged 20 issues in 18 records. This synthetic dataset has 18 problems planted on purpose, and the checks caught 18 of 18. The extra flags are knock-on effects: one wrong date can trip more than one check.

Check Issues What it means
Branching logic violation 3 A value sits in a question that should be hidden
Date order 3 Dates across events are in an impossible order
Implausible gestational age 3 Gestational age at birth outside 22 to 44 weeks
Missing required field 6 A required question was left blank
Out of range 4 Value outside the limits set in the data dictionary
Possible duplicate 1 Same person may be enrolled twice

Issues to resolve

The full list, ready to send to the study coordinator. It is also saved as outputs/qc_issues.csv.
